database_note: The Matches table records individual wrestling transactions, linking to Cards for event context, Wrestlers for participants, Match_Types for style, and Belts for titles. Cards serve as the central hub for events, connecting to Locations for venues, Promotions for brands, and Events for series names. Tables act as containers for Cards, while sqlite_sequence tracks auto-increment values. To join data, use Matches.card_id to Cards.id, Matches.winner_id and Matches.loser_id to Wrestlers.id, Matches.match_type_id to Match_Types.id, Matches.title_id to Belts.id, Cards.location_id to Locations.id, Cards.promotion_id to Promotions.id, and Cards.event_id to Events.id. This structure separates static definitions from dynamic match records.
